Hal ogolaansho oo kale ayaa loo baahan yahay

Fur Waaiya oo mar kale samee habaynta hal mar ah (“Wireless debugging”, Shizuku ama kombiyuutar). Hadda waxay sidoo kale ogolaanaysaa badhankan dejinta degdegga ah. Taleefannada Xiaomi, marka hore daar “USB debugging (Security settings)” gudaha doorashooyinka horumariyaha (“Developer options”).
Habaynta hal mar ah ee taleefankan, oo sawirro leh. Sawirradu waxay ka yimaadeen hal taleefan: kaaga liisaska waxay u ekaan karaan si yar oo kala duwan, laakiin magacyadu waa isku mid.

Daar doorashooyinka horumariyaha (“Developer options”): gudaha “Settings” › “About phone”, taabo “Build number” 7 jeer (taleefannada qaarkood waxay ku hoos jirtaa “Software information”). Ka bood tallaabadan haddii “Developer options” horeyba u daaran yihiin.
